# Static --lang none --platform html builds emit content-hashed asset names by
# default so browsers and CDNs cache-bust on any byte change. The
# noCacheBust=true option opts back into stable filenames.

sngl generate --out=hashed app.sngl
sngl generate --opt noCacheBust=true --out=plain app.sngl

exists hashed/index.html
exists plain/index.html

# Default: stylesheet basename gets an 8-hex hash segment before the extension.
grep 'href="/assets/site\.[0-9a-f]{8}\.css"' hashed/index.html
exec ls hashed/assets/
stdout 'site\.[0-9a-f]{8}\.css'

# Default: file.path() image gets a hash segment too, and the IMG src matches.
grep 'src="/assets/logo\.[0-9a-f]{8}\.svg"' hashed/index.html
stdout 'logo\.[0-9a-f]{8}\.svg'

# noCacheBust: filenames stay plain.
grep 'href="/assets/site\.css"' plain/index.html
grep 'src="/assets/logo\.svg"' plain/index.html
exec ls plain/assets/
stdout '^logo\.svg$'
stdout '^site\.css$'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output {
    none {
        html(stylesheet="site.css")
    }
}

import here "file:."

const logo = here.path("logo.svg")

component main {
    image(src=logo)
}
-- site.css --
body { background: #fff; }
-- logo.svg --
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16"><rect width="16" height="16" fill="red"/></svg>
